note: Untested: the first recipe sized for one 16 GB GPU (RTX 5080 Laptop), 101M parameters with 32K-token windows, trained with --recompute --micro-batch 1. Measured on another GPU with --recompute, one window peaked at 1.5 GiB at 4K tokens, 2.7 GiB at 8K and 4.6 GiB at 16K: about 8 GiB at 32K by extrapolation. Its data is the classics for now (about 4.3M tokens, so the model mostly memorizes); it changes once a larger mixture exists.
